items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, after hours you would go to the Club Harlem, and you heard Wild Bill Davis at Little Belmont. [INTERVIEWEE] That's right.

ctx.x: "Honky Tonk" sold a million. He had more hits than Wild Bill Davis. For him it was a smart business move. But he told me, he said, "Ram, you must get in on this now." He had been playing for Ella, you see, and he was making
